excerpt_i18n.en: On July 20, the annual tech event "Hardcore Youth Tech Festival 5.0," spanning Alibaba's ATH business group and Taotian Group, kicked off simultaneously in Hangzhou and Beijing. The week-long festival features tech showcases, academic exchanges, an AI Hackathon, and more. During the opening ceremony, Taotian Group unveiled four latest technological achievements of the AIGX system: the Paitalitao full-modality real-time agent, the full-scenario AI creation workbench if Studio, the Coupella smart engine, and the Agentic recommendation system Dream. "The Hardcore Youth Tech Festival has been held for five consecutive years. Vigor and craftsmanship are the most valuable foundation of the festival and our entire team," said Zheng Bo, Alibaba ATH Vice President and Taotian Group Chief Scientist at the opening. "The four new AIGX technologies released today—from full-modality perception to content production, from causal inference to intent understanding—mark the evolution of AI from a tool to a true partner." It is reported that in the AIGI direction, the Paitalitao full-modality real-time agent has officially gone live. This technology upgrades the original "search by photo for similar items" tool into a video shopping companion that "accompanies you while shopping, helps you choose, and saves you money," enabling transition from "seeing" to "understanding" with a single command.
